```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, dpi = 150
)

library(here); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
library(scales); library(sf); library(knitr); library(kableExtra)

data_path <- here("shiny_app", "gap_finder", "data", "shiny_data.rds")
app_data <- readRDS(data_path)
safe_get <- function(name) if (name %in% names(app_data)) app_data[[name]] else NULL

publisher_summary  <- safe_get("publisher_summary")
publisher_cell_dep <- safe_get("publisher_cell_dependency")
publisher_taxonomy <- safe_get("publisher_taxonomy")
grid_10km          <- safe_get("grid_10km")
admin_level1       <- safe_get("admin_level1")

pal <- list(sage = "#2A7F62", slate = "#4477AA", sand = "#CCBB44",
            coral = "#EE6677", plum = "#AA3377")
theme_gaps <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#666", size = 11),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
theme_set(theme_gaps)

# Publisher classification — IDENTICAL to the Shiny app's classify_publisher()
# (app.R) so the report's categories tie out to the dashboard. Three buckets:
# Citizen science, Private sector, and Research data (the default: universities,
# museums, herbaria, government agencies, field stations, etc.).
classify_publisher <- function(name) {
  name_lc <- tolower(name)
  dplyr::case_when(
    # Citizen science — public observation platforms & recording networks
    grepl("artdatabanken|artportalen|inaturalist|naturalist|ebird|bird\\.se|observation\\.org|svalan|fågel|naturgucker|naturglucker", name_lc) ~ "Citizen science",
    # Private sector — consultancies & companies
    grepl("\\bab\\b|aktiebolag|consult|calluna|ecocom|ecogain|naturcentrum|medins|pelagia|enetjärn|greensway|\\bwsp\\b|sweco|niras|\\bafry\\b|\\bltd\\b|\\bllc\\b|\\binc\\b|gmbh|corporation", name_lc) ~ "Private sector",
    # Research data — universities, museums, herbaria, government agencies, etc.
    TRUE ~ "Research data"
  )
}

# Category palette — identical to the app's pub_cat_colors
cat_colors <- c("Citizen science" = "#2A7F62",
                "Private sector"  = "#CCBB44",
                "Research data"   = "#4477AA")

truncate_name <- function(x, n = 40) ifelse(nchar(x) > n, paste0(substr(x, 1, n-1), "\u2026"), x)
```

# Overview

```{r pub-stats}
if (!is.null(publisher_summary)) {
  n_pub <- nrow(publisher_summary)
  n_single <- if (!is.null(publisher_cell_dep)) sum(publisher_cell_dep$n_publishers == 1) else NA
  n_cells <- if (!is.null(grid_10km)) nrow(grid_10km) else NA
  top <- publisher_summary |> arrange(desc(total_occurrences)) |> slice(1)
  top_pct <- round(100 * top$total_occurrences / sum(publisher_summary$total_occurrences), 1)

  stats <- tibble(
    Metric = c("Total publishers", "Total datasets",
               "Single-publisher cells", "Largest publisher", "Top publisher share"),
    Value = c(comma(n_pub),
              comma(sum(publisher_summary$n_datasets, na.rm = TRUE)),
              paste0(comma(n_single), " / ", comma(n_cells)),
              if ("publisher_name" %in% names(top)) top$publisher_name else "?",
              paste0(top_pct, "%"))
  )
  kable(stats, align = c("l", "r")) |> kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
}
```

# Top Publishers by Occurrences

```{r top-occ, fig.height=8}
if (!is.null(publisher_summary) && "publisher_name" %in% names(publisher_summary)) {
  df <- publisher_summary |>
    arrange(desc(total_occurrences)) |> head(20) |>
    mutate(
      name = ifelse(!is.na(publisher_name), publisher_name, publishingorgkey),
      short = truncate_name(name),
      category = classify_publisher(ifelse(!is.na(publisher_name), publisher_name, ""))
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(short, total_occurrences), y = total_occurrences, fill = category)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cat_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Top 20 Publishers by Occurrence Volume",
         x = "", y = "Total occurrences", fill = "Category") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))
}
```

# Publisher Category Breakdown

```{r category-table}
if (!is.null(publisher_summary) && "publisher_name" %in% names(publisher_summary)) {
  df <- publisher_summary |>
    mutate(category = classify_publisher(
      ifelse(!is.na(publisher_name), publisher_name, ""))) |>
    group_by(category) |>
    summarise(
      Publishers = n(),
      Occurrences = sum(total_occurrences, na.rm = TRUE),
      Species = sum(n_species, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(`% Occ` = round(100 * Occurrences / sum(Occurrences), 1)) |>
    arrange(desc(Occurrences))

  kable(df, align = c("l", rep("r", 4)), format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) |>
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
}
```

# Publisher Dependency Map

```{r dep-map, fig.height=9}
if (!is.null(grid_10km) && !is.null(publisher_cell_dep)) {
  map_sf <- grid_10km |>
    left_join(publisher_cell_dep |> select(eeacellcode, n_publishers), by = "eeacellcode") |>
    mutate(
      n_publishers = tidyr::replace_na(n_publishers, 0L),
      dep_cat = case_when(
        n_publishers == 0 ~ "No data",
        n_publishers == 1 ~ "1 (fragile)",
        n_publishers <= 3 ~ "2–3",
        n_publishers <= 5 ~ "4–5",
        TRUE ~ "6+"
      ) |> factor(levels = c("No data", "1 (fragile)", "2–3", "4–5", "6+"))
    )

  dep_colors <- c("No data" = "#e8e8e8", "1 (fragile)" = pal$coral,
                  "2–3" = "#CCBB44", "4–5" = pal$sage, "6+" = pal$slate)

  p <- ggplot(map_sf) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = dep_cat), color = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = dep_colors, name = "Publishers per cell") +
    labs(title = "Publisher Dependency per Grid Cell",
         subtitle = "Cells with only one publisher are fragile") +
    theme_void() + theme(legend.position = "right")
  if (!is.null(admin_level1)) {
    p <- p + geom_sf(data = st_transform(admin_level1, st_crs(map_sf)),
                     fill = NA, color = "#888", linewidth = 0.3)
  }
  print(p)
}
```

# Taxonomic Coverage by Publisher

Which publishers dominate for specific taxonomic groups?

```{r pub-taxonomy, fig.height=8}
if (!is.null(publisher_taxonomy) && !is.null(publisher_summary) &&
    "publisher_name" %in% names(publisher_summary)) {
  # Top 5 kingdoms by occurrence
  top_kingdoms <- publisher_taxonomy |>
    group_by(kingdom) |>
    summarise(occ = sum(total_occurrences, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(occ)) |> head(5) |> pull(kingdom)

  for (k in top_kingdoms) {
    pt <- publisher_taxonomy |> filter(kingdom == k) |>
      group_by(publishingorgkey) |>
      summarise(occ = sum(total_occurrences, na.rm = TRUE),
                spp = sum(n_species, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
      left_join(publisher_summary |> select(publishingorgkey, publisher_name),
                by = "publishingorgkey") |>
      mutate(name = ifelse(!is.na(publisher_name), publisher_name, publishingorgkey),
             short = truncate_name(name, 35),
             category = classify_publisher(ifelse(!is.na(publisher_name), publisher_name, ""))) |>
      arrange(desc(occ)) |> head(10)

    p <- ggplot(pt, aes(x = reorder(short, occ), y = occ, fill = category)) +
      geom_col() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = cat_colors) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(title = paste0("Top Publishers — ", k),
           x = "", y = "Occurrences", fill = "") +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
    print(p)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

# All Publishers

```{r pub-table}
if (!is.null(publisher_summary)) {
  df <- publisher_summary |>
    arrange(desc(total_occurrences)) |>
    mutate(
      name = if ("publisher_name" %in% names(publisher_summary))
        ifelse(!is.na(publisher_name), publisher_name, publishingorgkey)
        else publishingorgkey,
      pct = round(100 * total_occurrences / sum(total_occurrences), 2)
    ) |>
    select(Publisher = name, Occurrences = total_occurrences, `Share %` = pct,
           Species = n_species, Cells = n_cells)

  kable(df |> head(30), align = c("l", rep("r", 4)),
    format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) |>
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11)
}
```
